argv:
set -u
printf 'SECTION identity\n'
hostname || true
uname -a || true
id || true
printf 'SECTION deps\n'
for x in python3 perl prove git bash findmnt fusermount3 mountpoint stat df ps pgrep sha256sum tar make gcc cc; do printf '%s=' "$x"; command -v "$x" || true; done
python3 --version 2>&1 || true
perl -MTAP::Harness -e 'print $TAP::Harness::VERSION,"\n"' 2>&1 || true
git --version 2>&1 || true
printf 'SECTION filesystems\n'
findmnt -no TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS / /var /var/tmp /home /opt 2>&1 || true
df -B1 -T / /var/tmp /home /opt 2>&1 || true
stat -f -c 'path=%n type=%T blocks=%b bavail=%a bsize=%S files=%c ffree=%d' / /var/tmp /home /opt 2>&1 || true
printf 'SECTION suites-search\n'
find /var/tmp /opt /home -maxdepth 8 \( -path '*/pjdfstest/.git' -o -path '*/pjdfstest/tests' -o -path '*/ltp' -o -path '*/runtest' -o -name 'runltp' -o -name 'ltp-pan' \) -print 2>/dev/null | sort | head -200
printf 'SECTION suite-hashes\n'
for d in $(find /var/tmp /opt /home -maxdepth 8 -type d -name pjdfstest 2>/dev/null | sort); do
  printf 'pjdfstest_dir=%s\n' "$d"
  git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD 2>&1 || true
  git -C "$d" status --short 2>&1 | head -40 || true
  test -d "$d/tests" && find "$d/tests" -type f | wc -l || true
  test -f "$d/pjdfstest" && sha256sum "$d/pjdfstest" || true
done
for d in $(find /var/tmp /opt /home -maxdepth 8 -type d \( -name ltp -o -name ltp-full-* -o -name ltp-202* \) 2>/dev/null | sort); do
  printf 'ltp_dir=%s\n' "$d"
  git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD 2>&1 || true
  git -C "$d" status --short 2>&1 | head -40 || true
  find "$d" -maxdepth 3 \( -name runltp -o -name ltp-pan -o -path '*/testcases/bin/open01' -o -path '*/testcases/bin/read01' -o -path '*/testcases/bin/write01' -o -path '*/testcases/bin/stat01' -o -path '*/testcases/bin/chmod01' -o -path '*/testcases/bin/fcntl14' \) -print 2>/dev/null | sort | head -80
done
printf 'SECTION packages\n'
find /var/tmp /opt /home -maxdepth 8 \( -name 'afs-managed-package-6d51aeb.tar.gz' -o -name manifest.json -o -name afs-meta -o -name afs-node \) -print 2>/dev/null | sort | head -250
for f in /var/tmp/afs-managed-package-6d51aeb.tar.gz $(find /opt /var/tmp /home -maxdepth 8 -type f \( -name afs-meta -o -name afs-node \) 2>/dev/null | sort | head -40); do
  test -e "$f" && ls -l "$f" && sha256sum "$f" || true
done
printf 'SECTION active-afs\n'
pgrep -a afs-meta || true
pgrep -a afs-node || true
findmnt -R | grep -E 'afs|fuse' || true
